Recorded claim:
Bug 1852699 removed the Thunderbird default pref extensions.legacy.enabled and its comment that said it allowed legacy XUL/XPCOM extensions. D210020 accepted this specific dead-code removal. The old pref is absent from the current checkout search. Treat the 2024 default as historical; new extension work should use current extension APIs and should not assume this switch enables legacy add-ons. The broad Bug 1852699 has many unrelated cleanup patches, so this claim applies only to this preference.

Provenance: 002b618136100d7d4a5e35001582dac0ecbdbddb5d2fb2405afd9b7052befa37. Original evidence IDs: 25b66a91661f9955649da8b7ff901a3c0d5ae56bd0c86db3d5200b7fea026672, ad2f7bdceb5958826471b7bef454c52282cb966f3dcf4d1a076ab404af0b074c, b1851d42b3455d77ac460692f7e90caf7979f117f4ee34877f2d1d60c92153b4.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.

title: Recorded lesson: Do not rely on the removed extensions.legacy.enabled default
